{{Quote|Shortly after the Battle of Geonosis, our troop transport got caught between two Separatist gunships. They fired at us with everything they had. We crashed. Most of us were either dead or severely injured. When they started going through the wounded, killing us off, I knew there was no hope. I ran. It still haunts me.|Cut Lawquane|audio=ItStillHauntsMe-TD.flac|<ref name="The Deserter" />}}
In the wake of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], a pair of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] '''ambushed''' a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Troop/Legends|troop]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. In the resulting battle, the Republic transport crashed, [[Death/Legends|killing]] or severely injuring most of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on board. The Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] pursued the downed craft and began killing off the wounded [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], leading one of them, [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut Lawquane]], to flee from the battlefield and abandon his service to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].
